t: 霍斯罗二世,萨珊帝国的沙罕沙被推翻.
te: Khosrow II, Shahanshah of the Sasanian Empire, is overthrown.
dz: 霍斯罗二世,萨珊帝国的沙罕沙被推翻.
de: Khosrow II, Shahanshah of the Sasanian Empire, is overthrown.

t: 霍斯罗二世是萨珊帝国(伊朗)最后一位大沙阿被他的儿子卡瓦德二世所推翻.
te: Khosrow II, the last great Shah of the Sasanian Empire (Iran), is overthrown by his son Kavadh II.
